AccessTokenMandatory.name: token
AccessTokenMandatory.description: Access token received in auth request.

AccessTokenOptional.name: token
AccessTokenOptional.description: Access token received in auth request. Must be specified either here or in a request body.

result.description: OK if success, error description otherwise

type.description: Mixing type. Single mixing type means use single source video as output. All mixing type means mix all active source videos into output.

source-index.description: Mandatory for single mixing type. Specifies active source, 0-based index of sources array. Makes sense for single mixing type only, otherwise should not be specified.

audio-source-image.description: Index of the source which should be used to display audio-only source in output video. This source should provide only a video track, preferably single image.

layers.description: Arranges the sources based on layers. Higher layer has higher z order, i.e. overlaps below layers. Makes sense for mixing type 'all' only, otherwise should not be specified.

sources.description: List of source indices which should be shown on this layer. At least one source must be specified. If layout type is manual then only one source must be specified.

layout.description: Layout type. Manual means user must specify source location in the output video. Auto means server arranges the sources in the output video automatically.

stretch.description:
Source stretch type.
Preserve means stretch image to the outer boundaries while preserving aspect ratio and keeping the whole image visible.
Fill means stretch image to the outer boundaries without preserving aspect ratio, i.e. fill the boundaries completely. The whole image remains visible.
Zoom means stretch and center image to fill the outer boundaries completely while keeping aspect ratio. Not fitting up/down or top/bottom parts could be cut out.

location.description: Location of the source in the output video. Can be specified for 'manual' layout type. If not specified then the location will be equal to output image.

opacity.description: Opacity of the layer. Must be in 0.0..1.0 range.

fade-in.description: Fade in duration in milliseconds. If not specified or has value of 0 means no fade in.

fade-out.description: Fade out duration in milliseconds. If not specified or has value of 0 means no fade out.

type.description: Mixing type. Single mixing type means use single source audio as output. All mixing type means mix all active source audios into output.

source-index.description: Mandatory for single mixing type. Specifies active source, 0-based index of sources array. Makes sense for single mixing type only, otherwise should not be specified.

format.description: Sink format if it is not defined expicitly by URI.

auto-restore.description: Whether to re-create sink automatically in case of error

expected-duration.description: Expected recorded file duration, should be in TimeSpan parseable format. Makes sense for file sink only, otherwise should not be specified.

write-media-data-last.description: Whether to write media data box as a last box in MP4 container. Makes sense for file sink only, otherwise should not be specified.

write-state.description: Whether to write state into VASTreaming custom box. Makes sense for file sink only, otherwise should not be specified.

auto-complete-state.description: Whether to set complete state automatically on file close in VASTreaming custom box. Makes sense for file sink only, otherwise should not be specified.

write-header-update-interval.description: Interval between writing of updated header to a file, in frames. Makes sense for file sink only, otherwise should not be specified.

minimal-free-disk-space.description: Minimal free disk space required to continue file writing, in bytes. Makes sense for file sink only, otherwise should not be specified.

token.description: Access token received in auth request. Must be specified either here or in URL query.

path.description: Publishing path. Output stream will be available via proto://server:port/<publishing_path>.

title.description: Human readable description of the publishing point.

allowed-protocols.description: Allow this publishing point to be accessed via specified protocols. Possible values: all, none or comma separated lists of protocols. Supported protocols: rtmp, rtsp, hls, dash, rtc, mjpeg.

expiration-timeout.description: Timeout in seconds publishing point expires after creation and is disposed on streaming server. 0 means no expiration timeout.

inactivity-timeout.description: Inactivity timeout in seconds after which publishing point is disposed on streaming server. Inactivity means no connected clients to any of publishing point sinks. 0 means no inactivity timeout.

no-samples-timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds after which mixing source decides that source is down and starts producing substitute samples. Makes sense for mixing source only, otherwise should not be specified.

allow-absolute-timestamps.description: Rely on absolute (NTP) timestamps in mixing source procesing logic. Makes sense for mixing source only, otherwise should not be specified.

allow-video-processing.description: Whether to allow video processing such as mixing of multiple video sources into an output.

loop.description: Whether publishing point sources should be played in an endless loop. Makes sense for file based sources only.

user-data.description: Any user specific data to attach to the publishing point.

sources.description: Publishing point sources. At least one source must be specified.

uri.description: Full source URI for pull source, vast://publishing-point/path for push source or vast://text for text source.

format.description: Source format if it is not defined expicitly by URI.

content.description: Content of the text block. Makes sense for text source only, otherwise should not be specified.

loop.description: Whether source should be played in an endless loop. Makes sense for file based source only, otherwise should not be specified.

interval-from.description: Offset from the beginning of the file to start playback from. Should be in TimeSpan parseable format. Makes sense for file source only, otherwise should not be specified.

interval-to.description: Offset from the beginning of the file to stop playback at. Should be in TimeSpan parseable format. Makes sense for file source only, otherwise should not be specified.

no-input-timeout.description: Timeout in seconds after which mixing source fails with error if there are no active inputs producing any samples. Makes sense for mixing source only, otherwise should not be specified. 0 means no timeout.

delete-file-on-close.description: Whether to delete source file when closing the source. Makes sense for publishing point with file source only.

width.description: Text block width. Makes sense for text source only, otherwise should not be specified. If not specified then the output video width will be used as a text block width.

height.description: Text block height. Makes sense for text source only, otherwise should not be specified. If not specified then the output video width will be used as a text block height.

horizontal-alignment.description: Horizontal content alignment within a text block. Makes sense for text source only, otherwise should not be specified.

vertical-alignment.description: Vertical content alignment within a text block. Makes sense for text source only, otherwise should not be specified.

decoration.description: Text decoration. Makes sense for text source only, otherwise should not be specified.

color.description: Font color as a hex string. Accepted formats: #ARGB, #RGB, ARGB, RGB.

outline-color.description: Outline color as a hex string. Accepted formats: #ARGB, #RGB, ARGB, RGB.

outline-width.description: Outline width. If not specified or has value of 0 means no outline.

background-color.description: Background color of the text block as a hex string. Accepted formats: #ARGB, #RGB, ARGB, RGB.

processing.description: Should be specified when source processing is necessary. Otherwise source will be dispatched to sinks as is.

discard.description: If set to true then source video track(s) will be discarded. If set to true then no other elements should be present in 'video' object.

transcoding.description: Whether to transcode source video. Default value is false, i.e. dispatch source video track(s) to sinks as is. If there are multiple sources then transcoding must be set to true.

mixing.description: Common mixing settings for all video tracks.

tracks.description: If not specified then dispatch source video track(s) to sinks as is. If transcoding is true then mandatory.

index.description: 0-based track index. Global for video and audio tracks.

framerate.description: Output framerate in rational format: numerator/denominator.

bitrate.description: Output bitrate in bits per second.

level.description: Float codec level value multiplied by 10.

discard.description: If set to true then source audio track(s) will be discarded. If set to true then no other elements should be present in 'audio' object.

transcoding.description: Whether to transcode source audio. Default value is false, i.e. dispatch source audio track(s) to sinks as is. If there are multiple sources then transcoding must be set to true.

mixing.description: Common mixing settings for all audio tracks.

tracks.description: If not specified then dispatch source audio track(s) to sinks as is. If transcoding is true then mandatory.

index.description: 0-based track index. Global for video and audio tracks.

bitrate.description: Output bitrate in bits per second.

sinks.description: List of sinks to be created after successful publishing point creation.

get.description: Test download speed from the server

200.description: Server returns a big chunk of data with content type video/mp4. Returned data must not be played because it’s not a real mp4 file but a garbage data. Client code can use a download time to calculate actual download speed from the server.

post.description: Test upload speed to the server. Client should send a big chunk of data in request body. Server replies OK and client can use response reception time to calculate actual upload speed to the server.
